messages:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — packaging/pricing deploy gatekeeper. Need final owners for metering adapter, billing adapter, quota guardrails, and contract edge-cases. Rolling to prod Fri EOD unless blockers. Who owns final sign-off on quota mapping?

Sam Ortiz: I can take metering adapter sign-off. ETA Wed COB for integration tests. @Priya can you confirm billing adapter readiness?

Priya Nair: billing adapter: infra + schema done. Need one more e2e with ratecard v2. ETA Thu AM. @Igor can you do billing-side load tests on dedicated?

Igor Petrov: Yep — running load test job now. If we see >30% increased token rate we'll need to tweak batching windows. Will post results here. Job id: job-2974-batchcheck

Avery Patel: Contract exceptions: Legal flagged two cases re: enterprise quotas + refunds. I can coordinate, but need clear fallback SLA text. @LegalBot any auto-doc template?

LegalBot: Legal template v3 available: /docs/contracts/quota-refunds-v3.md. Suggest adding explicit overage clause, and a 30-day grace for migrated customers.

BillingBot: Note: metering schema change will bump event size by +12 bytes. Risk: ingestion spikes. Recommend a short-lived backfill window and schedule for processing.

Maya Chen: OK — ownership summary so far: metering = Sam, billing = Priya, load tests = Igor, contracts = Avery/legal. Quota guardrails — unassigned. Can someone from platform own quota enforcement (circuit-breaker + metrics export)?

Sam Ortiz: Platform owns runtime enforcement historically. Tagging @eng-platform.

Igor Petrov: Also watch for cache invalidation when we flip packaging flags — KV cache TTL drop can cause token spike.

Priya Nair: For e2e: test matrix I'm using:
```
env: staging
ratecard: v2
seq_len: [128,512,2048]
batching: auto
```
Please add a long-seq test if you have time.

Avery Patel: I'll consolidate legal notes in the PR description. Any objections to including the SLA snippet now?

Maya Chen: No objections. Can we get final "go/no-go" approvals by Thu 3pm? If not, postpone to Mon next week.

Sam Ortiz: Ack. Will ping mid-Wed with test status.

Igor Petrov: Load test complete: 85th p90 latency stable, token/sec within expected; saw brief token spike at 50m mark — tied to KV TTL. Creating follow-up ticket: INF-7123.

Priya Nair: E2E passed for most cases, failing 2048 length under batching:auto; will try manual batching and update PR.

Maya Chen: Thanks — leaving action items: Sam run backfill plan doc, Priya fix 2048, Igor file INF-7123, Avery/legal finalize SLA text. Ping me when done. :thumbsup:
